# Poodle Circle

> Free owner guides for people who just brought home a toy poodle. Not a clinic. No puppy sales.

Poodle Circle (https://poodlecircle.com/) is a community journal for toy poodle companions. The page to start on is the first 30 days path. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/poodle.circle/

These are owner routines, not veterinary advice. A puppy who is weak, collapsing, or refusing food should see a veterinarian.

## Start here

- [Your first 30 days with a toy poodle](https://poodlecircle.com/first-30-days/): four weeks, one page to open each week, ticks saved on the device.
- [The full first 30 days guide](https://poodlecircle.com/30daysguide/): the long version of the same month.
- [Free First 30 Days Kit PDF](https://poodlecircle.com/assets/first-30-days-kit.pdf): checklists plus the guide. No email signup.

## The four weeks

- Days 1 to 7: one quiet room, a toilet trip, and sleep. Set up the sleeping area, a feeding routine, and a plan for the first vet visit. Guide: https://poodlecircle.com/30daysguide/#day-1
- Days 8 to 14: alone time for about a minute, then brushing, then the harness indoors.
- Days 15 to 21: apartment barking first, then teeth, then grooming at home.
- Days 22 to 30: notice what still needs attention. Night waking is only for a dog who had settled and then started barking again.

## Direct answers

The first night with a toy poodle is one quiet room where the puppy can hear you, a toilet trip, then sleep. Skip visitors, tricks, and a tour of the house.

Line brushing means parting the coat and combing from the skin out, especially ears, armpits, groin, and behind the legs. If the comb will not pass, stop and book a groomer. Do not cut a mat out with scissors.

Toy poodle tear stains: once a day, wipe from the inner corner outward with water and dry the fur. No whitening drops. One eye suddenly worse, squinting, or thick discharge belongs with a vet.

Toy poodle teeth: toothpaste made for dogs, a few teeth, stop while they are calm. Do not use human toothpaste.

A toy poodle should walk on a fitted harness, not a collar. Two fingers of room, chest strap behind the front legs, and a short indoor lift test before the street.

Alone time starts in seconds and minutes. Two hours is a later step for a dog who already settles. A young puppy should not be left for a workday.

Apartment barking: reward a quiet second away from the door. Shouting adds noise. Opening the door mid bark teaches them that barking works.

Night waking after the first month is often a last toilet, a daytime nap, or a habit of getting an answer. The first night is a different page.

Stairs: carry a young toy poodle on a full flight. Cold: if you want a coat, they are already colder. Hawks: in open country, keep a dog this size close and on a lead.
